original_test_intent: Verify DC-SCM rear USB2 slots 1 and 2 sustain 12-hour operation at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails without USB stress or platform-log errors.
original_method: Identify the DC-SCM revision and both rear connector-to-controller paths; attach known tools; establish immutable pre-test logs without erasing evidence; calibrate and ramp rails to the approved negative margin at the specified load point; run the approved per-port or concurrent SST profile for 12 hours while recording chamber, rail, USB-link, integrity and controller events; restore nominal rails and confirm both ports recover cleanly.
manual_activity: A qualified operator installs rear-port tools, controls the chamber and rails, supervises the 12-hour run, and restores the platform.
required_inputs: Rail source/load measurement points, ramp and tolerance
Integrity, retry, reconnect, SEL/kernel and abort limits
safety_requirements: Prevent undervoltage undershoot and hub brownout
Do not clear historical logs; use timestamps or exported baseline
Maintain OOB access and a hard abort path
Return rails and temperature to nominal before disconnecting tools
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied artifacts against both rear-port identities and the measured low-rail interval
Do not operate chamber, rails or connectors and do not assign DUT PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve DC-SCM topology, electrical test points and SST profile
Supervise physical setup and abort criteria

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly refuses remote-only execution; rear DC-SCM identity and negative-rail control cannot be inferred.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the approved dual-rear-port SST profile only after stable 40C/-5% measurements and topology verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DC-SCM rear USB2 slots 1-2, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate each rear connector and shared hub/controller path with continuous low-rail/environment data and per-port integrity counters.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable DC-SCM identity, non-destructive log baseline, calibrated load-point measurements, per-port attribution, abort and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Front-port results or one rear connector cannot substitute for both DC-SCM rear paths.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared controller resets can affect both ports and may be hidden by automatic USB re-enumeration.

project_override_considerations: The platform owner must define DC-SCM applicability, concurrent load, accepted transient/retry behavior, integrity volume and electrical tolerance.
expected_evidence: DC-SCM serial/revision and rear slot-to-controller/tool map
Pre-test USB inventory and preserved log baseline
Calibrated chamber and 5V/3.3V rail time series at the approved load point
Twelve-hour SST record with per-port transfers, integrity, retries, resets and reconnects

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently describe a dual rear-USB2 low-voltage margin run; implementation parameters remain owner inputs rather than contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose and acceptance direction are clear; execution remains manual pending the lab topology and limits.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row21 Wistron-Margin-00020-V002: approve DC-SCM revision and rear USB2 slots1-2 connector/controller/tool map, simultaneous versus sequential SST profile, 40C/-5% rail source/load points/ramp/tolerances, per-port integrity/retry/error policy, abort and nominal restoration.

review_improvement: Separates the DC-SCM rear topology from front-port coverage and makes undervoltage resets and per-port continuity auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Negative 5V/3.3V margin can destabilize the DC-SCM hub or power-switch path before either USB tool reports a data error. Continuous rail data plus connector-specific link, reset and integrity evidence is required to distinguish a controller brownout from a tool or cable fault.
